tier_reason: Tier A stands (public gist harness, GCC 6.3 -O3 -march=native, i5-5200U), but the caveats must say the timed lookups never read the stored value and that inserts, erases and short-key reads are not faster; maintenance is stale.

corrections.caveats: 2017 hat-trie README benchmark: long-key reads 1.70x faster than std::unordered_map (Wikipedia 138.24 vs 173.58 ns/key, Askitis 46.41 vs 105.05), but the lookups only test find() != end() and array_map never touches its separate values vector, so the value read is untimed; inserts without reserve (2.02 vs 1.68 s) and erases are slower, short-key reads trail robin_map, ska and hopscotch; no absl::flat_hash_map column; non-default StoreNullTerminator=false; best-of-20 driver not public. Only CI and CMake bumps since 2022. Filed under stdlib-replacements/hash-maps-sets by category override.
